name: James Warren Tea Limited
about: James Warren Tea Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of tea in India. It primarily offers CTC and orthodox tea products. The company also operates various tea estates located in the South Bank, Upper Assam, as well as offers black tea under the Assam1860 brand name. It exports its products to the United Kingdom, the United States, Germany, Iran, the Middle East, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Dashabhooja Mercantile & Tourism Private Limited. James Warren Tea Limited was founded in 1850 and is based in Kolkata, India.
